name: Prueba de Secrets y Runner

on: [push]

jobs:
  comparar-tokens:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      - name: Comprobar tokens
        env:
          DEV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DEV_TOKEN }}
          LOCAL_DEV: ${{ env.LOCAL_DEV_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          echo "Valor en GitHub Secret: $DEV_TOKEN"
          echo "Valor en Variable Local: $LOCAL_DEV"
          
          if [ "$DEV_TOKEN" = "$LOCAL_DEV" ]; then
            echo "¡Coinciden! Los tokens son iguales."
          else
            echo "¡No coinciden! Los tokens son diferentes."
            exit 1
          fi
